args.title: Bellwether Office newsletter summary — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
• Newsletter: Bellwether Office's latest issue covers "Cold-chain logistics in 2026," linking to a blog article plus a personalized companion piece.
• Main article (blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece (insights.bellwether.example, tailored for Northwind Analytics): Pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (25%).
